rows.top_chunk: Full-time staff earn 21 working days of paid annual leave in each leave year. The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
Leave requests go to the line manager on the leave form at least 14 days before the first day of leave. The line manager answers within 3 working days.
Approval limits for one expense claim are as follows. Up to UGX 200,000: the line manager. From UGX 200,001 to UGX 2,000,000: the Finance Manager. Above UGX 2,000,000: the Managing Director.
Staff may claim reasonable business expenses. Receipts must reach the Finance office within 14 days of the spending.

Overtime must be approved by the line manager before it is worked. Approved overtime is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate on weekdays and 2 times the normal hourly rate on Sundays and public holidays.
Staff must not paste customer personal data, price lists or contracts into a public AI tool or website unless the Managing Director has approved that tool in writing.
A lost or stolen laptop or phone, and any suspected loss of data, is reported to the Operations Manager within 4 hours of discovery.

A staff member travelling outside Jinja on company business receives a meal allowance of UGX 40,000 a day. The Operations office books accommodation in advance. The cost may not exceed UGX 180,000 a night.
